### Borea v0.3.1

A fix release for v0.3.0. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixes

- Play no longer needs the internet when the mod loader is installed. Borea chooses the loader from the content index it already has, so the game starts at once. Before, Play asked SpaceDock first, and when SpaceDock or your connection did not answer, it waited for 100 seconds and then showed an unexpected error. If Borea has no content index yet and cannot load one, Play now tells you why. The same applies to `borea launch`. Thanks to @Kiwi-Shark for the report.
- A click beside a text field, for example on the empty page next to the Discover search, now takes the focus from the field, so its cursor and its highlight go away and your keys no longer go into it. In a modal, Tab stays in the modal and Escape still closes it. Thanks to @LaurensDeV for the report.
